newsitem.title: USA: Spartan adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Spartan adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Spartan Motors Inc said its board approved a shareholder rights plan.
The maker of custom chassis for motorhomes, fire trucks, school buses and other vehicles said it is not seeking a sale of the company. "Nor are there any current bidders for the company," it said.

The company said its board approved a preferred stock purchase rights plan allowing shareholders to buy a new series of Spartan stock "in the event of coercive attempts to significantly shift company ownership."

The rights will be distributed to shareholders of record on July 7 and will be triggered if any person or group acquires 15 percent or more of Spartan Motors common stock without board approval, the company said.
The plan does not apply to shareholders who now own five percent or more of the company, it added.
